description: This Java class 'ReadableProductReview' extends 'ProductReviewEntity' and implements 'Serializable'. It adds a 'ReadableCustomer' field for customer information related to the product review.

classes.name: ReadableProductReview
classes.description: A Java class representing a readable product review, extending the base review entity and including customer information.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the ReadableCustomer associated with this review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the ReadableCustomer for this review.
